newsitem.title: CROATIA: CROATIAN STOCKS FORGE AHEAD LED BY PLIVA, ZABA.
newsitem.headline: CROATIAN STOCKS FORGE AHEAD LED BY PLIVA, ZABA.

text.p: Croatian stocks forged ahead on Thursday, led by advances to record levels by market favourites Pliva and Zagrebacka Banka.
* Thirteen of 18 active issues rose, only two fell and three closed flat.
* Volume shrank very slightly to 24,782 units with turnover falling to 11.4 million kuna from 18.6 million.
* Drugs firm Pliva was again the most actively traded issue with 9,516 shares sold. It ended at 600 kuna, up 16 or 2.74 percent, but down from an all-time intraday peak of 610 kuna.
* Ordinary stock of the other blue chip, Zagrebacka Banka, rose 58 kuna to 2,583, also off its peak of 2,585 earlier in the session. But only 235 shares changed hands.
* Fully-listed Varazdinska Banka's ordinaries led gainers, rising 26 kuna or 10.4 percent to 276 kuna on volume of 4,904.
* Hotelier Arenaturist was the bigger of the two losers, falling one kuna to 105 with 148 shares traded.
